Intelligence should be thought as a tool for thought, not an independent agent

These systems should be built on top of human intelligence, not replace it.

Next-token prediction is primitive to call a system intelligent.

Can a [transformers](/thoughts/Transformers) ever be [Turing-complete](/thoughts/Turing-complete-Transformers)?

## research area.

A lot of alpha in mechanistic analysis of the [representations](/thoughts/representations) these models exhibit., or "virtual brain analysis".
